data_description.scan_interval: How often to check i9 Sports for schedule updates. Default is 48 hours (172800 seconds). Minimum 5 minutes (300 seconds), maximum 24 hours (86400 seconds).
data_description.pre_event_update: Enable automatic polling shortly before upcoming games to catch last-minute schedule changes
data_description.pre_event_minutes: How many minutes before a game to perform an update check. Default is 120 minutes (2 hours). Range: 5-1440 minutes (24 hours).
